author: Baltic Analog Lab
title: Looking for illustrator for new merch
content: We’re looking for a freelance graphic designer (preferably based in Latvia) for occasional collaborations, as well as an illustrator (national or international) to create fun artwork for our new merch! 🦄 Send us a DM with your Instagram account or website. And if you know someone whose work you love, share your recommendations with us! ✨ Contact: DM on Instagram.

author: Ellen / imaginariumarts
title: Seeking ongoing artist for YouTube channel assets and character art
content: ARTISTS AND DESIGNERS LISTEN UP!!! A pal of mine recently started his YouTube channel journey, and is seeking an ongoing artist to commission for assets! This guy REALLY loves to support real life human artists... Detail update: seeking ongoing artist for main channel assets and branded designs... Preference given to those who can replicate Kirby style content and character drawing... You will be paid fair compensation, so be ready to send your rates... Contact: Comment on the post or DM. Full post includes more details on thumbnails, human-made art (not AI), and potential for ongoing work.
